items.title: Design the responsive web shell, authentication and recovery journeys
items.outcome: Signed-out and signed-in users can authenticate, recover and navigate the complete responsive customer product through an approved shell before T-WEB-01 is implemented.
items.context: The web shell owns session trust, help when locked out and the navigation model all later pages inherit. A generic dashboard shell would hide recovery and narrow-layout failures until every feature depends on it.
scope: Register, sign-in, channel verification, passkey, recovery, cooling-off, cancel, session expiry and sign-out
Signed-in desktop side navigation, narrow drawer, page header, breadcrumbs and deep-link landing
Overview route, global help/support entry and notification/status regions
Loading, error, offline/degraded, account-existence-safe and revoked-session states
Keyboard, screen-reader, 200 percent zoom and mobile-web behavior
acceptance_criteria: The prototype covers register through recovery cancellation with no dead end and no account enumeration difference
Every sitemap destination is represented and narrow web remains a complete fallback
Focus, skip links, landmarks, page titles, error summaries and session-timeout recovery are specified
Recovery shows restricted capabilities and remaining cooling-off time without promising instant access
T-WEB-01 has a complete D6 handoff with route, component, contract and test IDs
contracts_schema: Maps T-AUTH-01 session, recovery and error states plus T-UX-01 client states into screen specifications
security_privacy: Responses and timing designs reveal no account existence
No credential, recovery code or session value appears in mock data, URL or telemetry
observability: Auth task success, recovery cancellation, session expiry recovery, navigation first-click and locked-out support discovery
tests: Narrow layout and 200 percent zoom matrix
rollout_rollback: D6 handoff precedes T-WEB-01 Ready
A shell change versions routes and preserves deep-link redirects
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs and customer-web Figma file. The shell squad owns navigation/auth frames; feature squads consume its published templates without editing them.
definition_of_done: All shell and identity screens, states and responsive variants registered
Prototype and accessibility evidence accepted
Web Design Lead, Security, Content and CDO approvals recorded
D6 handoff published and dependencies mirrored

items.title: Design web accounts, transactions, bulk actions, imports and export
items.outcome: High-volume account, transaction, import, bulk-correction and full-export tasks are designed with deterministic previews, provenance and recovery before T-WEB-02 implementation.
items.context: The web product exists partly for large-screen and keyboard-heavy work. A list page alone does not define ten-thousand-row behavior, dry-run import, partial batch failure or trust-preserving export.
scope: Account list/detail/archive and transaction list/detail/edit/reverse
Search, filter, sort, cursor pagination, selection and bulk categorization
Statement mapping, validation, dry-run preview, duplicate/conflict review, commit and result
Cash and refund reconciliation, data-access log and deletion entry
Full export step-up, progress, expiry, failure and receipt
acceptance_criteria: Ten-thousand-row table behavior is specified for keyboard, screen reader, virtualized loading and narrow layouts
Import writes nothing before a reconciled preview and repeat import clearly produces no duplicate
Bulk partial failure identifies exactly what changed and offers retry without repeating success
Reversal and archive show ledger-safe consequence and recovery rather than destructive edit language
Full export shows scope, format, expiry and step-up and maps to T-WEB-02 tests
contracts_schema: Maps T-CON-10, T-CON-13, T-CON-17 and transaction/ledger errors to table, preview and receipt states
security_privacy: Tables mask sensitive values in privacy mode and exports never appear in browser storage
Bulk and export actions require scoped step-up without leaking hidden rows
observability: Import preview abandonment, mapping correction, bulk error, reversal undo and export completion without amounts or merchant content
rollout_rollback: D6 handoff precedes T-WEB-02 Ready
High-risk bulk patterns can ship disabled while read-only transaction design remains valid
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs and web product file. Transaction, import and export frames use separate owned sections and share only approved table and action components.
definition_of_done: All registered screens and states designed
Bulk/import/export prototype tasks pass
Money-path, Accessibility and Web Design approvals recorded
D6 handoff published and dependencies mirrored

items.title: Design the web debt dashboard, strategy comparison and derivation inspector
items.outcome: Users can understand payoff status, compare strategies, inspect derivations and explore extra-payment scenarios without mistaking projections for guarantees.
items.context: Debt is the product wedge and the densest proof surface. The design must make why a number exists as discoverable as the number itself.
scope: Debt overview, payoff status, progress, attention and not-on-track states
Debt detail, amortization schedule and derivation inspector
Strategy comparison with equal-weight options and table/chart parity
Extra-payment, lump-sum and target-date scenario builder and comparison
Budget/reporting context, disclaimer and stale/partial states
acceptance_criteria: Participants locate the derivation for a consequential figure within two actions
Strategies have equal visual weight until the user chooses and no default implies advice
Never-payoff, incomplete and stale results cannot be read as a valid payoff date
Every chart has a navigable table equivalent and server values are never recomputed
T-WEB-03 receives screen, component, content, contract and QA mappings
contracts_schema: Maps T-CON-01 debt, schedule, tagged projection, strategy and simulation results to registered states
security_privacy: No lender recommendation or user-specific product advice
Synthetic debt values only in artifacts and research
observability: Derivation opens, strategy comprehension, scenario correction, not-on-track recovery and report task success without amounts
rollout_rollback: D6 handoff precedes T-WEB-03 Ready
A strategy can remain hidden without invalidating other debt screens
non_goals: Advanced debt creation owned by T-UXW-04
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs and web debt section. Dashboard, derivation and scenario frames are separable branches over one approved debt component set.
definition_of_done: Debt screens and states registered
Critical prototype tasks pass
Money-path, Content, Accessibility and CDO approvals recorded
D6 handoff published and dependencies mirrored

items.title: Design web debt entry and advanced debt scenario workflows
items.outcome: Web-only users can create simple and advanced debt terms, understand validation and compare credit-card, prepayment and refinance scenarios before T-DEBT-05 implementation.
items.context: Web registration is standalone, so debt dashboards cannot assume debts came from Android. Advanced terms need progressive disclosure without hiding cost or trapping novice users.
scope: Debt type selection and progressive term entry
Credit-card cycle and minimum-payment trap
Prepayment penalty and refinance break-even builder
Utilization-first, highest-payment and highest-interest-cost strategy inputs
Validation, incomplete data, conflict and save receipt
acceptance_criteria: Simple entry completes without advanced terminology while advanced terms remain discoverable
Every rate, fee, cycle and minimum rule shows unit, effective date and validation
Incomplete or contradictory terms block projection with an actionable explanation
Refinance and prepayment remain neutral scenarios with full assumptions and no recommendation
T-DEBT-05 receives a complete D6 handoff and accessible test script
contracts_schema: Maps advanced T-CON-01 debt types and validation errors without a private web model
security_privacy: No creditor credentials or statement upload in this flow
Autosave and conflict designs protect values on shared devices
observability: Field correction, advanced disclosure, validation block and abandoned scenario without financial values
rollout_rollback: D6 handoff precedes T-DEBT-05 Ready
Advanced types can remain gated while basic debt entry stays usable
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs. Basic entry and advanced scenario sections can be designed in parallel against one debt-form component contract.
definition_of_done: All debt types and errors designed
Entry/comprehension tests pass
Money-path and Content approvals recorded
D6 handoff published and dependencies mirrored

items.title: Design the web clarification, candidate comparison and rule rollback inbox
items.outcome: Users can resolve ambiguity in batches, understand candidate precedence and safely preview or roll back learned rules on the web.
items.context: Clarification is the trust repair loop. A generic inbox would hide why one candidate won, what a rule changes and whether Android and web converge.
scope: Batched inbox/list and empty state
Candidate/source comparison and precedence explanation
Merchant/category correction and rule preview
Affected-count confirmation and rollback receipt
Conflict, stale, already-resolved and offline/degraded states
acceptance_criteria: Every T-CON-02 decision state has a screen treatment and no web-only status is invented
The chosen candidate and reason are understandable without raw-message content
Rule creation and rollback show affected scope before confirmation
Concurrent resolution explains the authoritative result and preserves the user's correction path
T-WEB-04 receives a complete D6 handoff
contracts_schema: Maps T-CON-02 and T-CON-15 candidate, decision, provenance, rule and conflict fields
security_privacy: Never renders raw message content or raw-derived digest
Candidate comparison reveals only structured fields authorized to the user
observability: Batch completion, candidate override, rule acceptance/rollback and conflict recovery without content
rollout_rollback: D6 handoff precedes T-WEB-04 Ready
Rule controls can be disabled while manual correction remains available
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs. Inbox, candidate comparison and rule lifecycle frames use shared decision components and separate branches.
definition_of_done: All inbox screens/states registered
Comprehension and conflict tests pass
Privacy and Accessibility approvals recorded
D6 handoff published and dependencies mirrored

items.title: Design web net worth, holdings, income, budgets and goals
items.outcome: Large-screen planning surfaces let users manage income, budgets, recurring items, holdings, net worth and competing goals with clear provenance, uncertainty and advice boundaries.
items.context: These related planning domains share time, category and scenario components but have distinct empty, stale and incomplete states. Combining them only at implementation would duplicate semantics.
scope: Net-worth overview, per-currency trend, drill-down and export
Holding create/edit/archive/revaluation/composition
Income setup, safe-to-spend, category budgets, bills, recurring and sinking funds
Goal list/detail/contribution, competition and scenario comparison
Salary-market provenance, stale/partial/incomplete and advice-boundary states
acceptance_criteria: No cross-currency scalar total appears without approved conversion and provenance
Stale holding valuation, incomplete income and partial plan states cannot appear current or complete
Goal competition shows tradeoffs as options and never instructs the user to take a job or investment
Budget and bill workflows remain operable by keyboard and at narrow width
T-NWT-03, T-NWT-06, T-INC-04 and T-GOL-03 receive exact D6 mappings
contracts_schema: Maps T-CON-08 and related income/goal/holding shapes, freshness, completeness and derivation
security_privacy: Salary-market data shows source and age without profiling individual employability
Privacy mode masks amounts without hiding state or action
observability: Planning task success, stale remediation, derivation opens and goal tradeoff comprehension without amounts
rollout_rollback: D6 mappings precede each implementation ticket Ready
Individual domains can remain gated without breaking the shared planning shell
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs. Net-worth/holdings and income/goals subteams own separate pages over shared planning and financial components.
definition_of_done: All mapped planning screens/states registered
Usability, comprehension and accessibility evidence accepted
Advice/money-path approvals recorded
D6 handoffs published and dependencies mirrored

items.title: Design web split groups, family sharing and household goals
items.outcome: Web sharing experiences support fair split work and consent-based household planning while making aggregate/detail boundaries, access history, revocation and discreet exit unmistakable.
items.context: Split and family workflows look similar but have different authorization and abuse risks. Household convenience must not normalize surveillance or reveal hidden detail through interface affordances.
scope: Split group create/invite/itemized expense/share/settle/dispute/simplify/export
Family invite/accept/grant/access log/revoke/leave/safe exit
Household partial aggregate and joint-goal contribution
Placeholder/non-user and eligibility states
Offline, cache eviction, suppressed, denied and coercive-control states
acceptance_criteria: Split allocations visibly reconcile to the expense before save and disputes remain visible to authorized members
Family defaults to aggregate and detail requires a separate explicit grant
Aggregate-only screens expose no detail affordance and partial/suppressed never appears zero
Revocation and discreet exit are reachable without giving a reason and cached content visibly becomes unavailable
T-SPL-04, T-FAM-04 and T-FAM-07 receive exact D6 handoffs
contracts_schema: Maps T-CON-04 grants, splits, disputes, access events, aggregate completeness, suppression and revocation bounds
security_privacy: Independent coercive-control review and safe recruitment are mandatory
No design permits group-wide implicit grants or differencing queries
observability: Grant escalation, revoke/exit reachability, dispute completion and suppressed-view events without relationship or amount data
rollout_rollback: D6 handoffs precede sharing implementation Ready
A sharing feature remains disabled if safety evidence expires
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs. Split and family subteams are separate; Security and Inclusive Design review shared authorization components before both use them.
definition_of_done: All sharing screens/states registered
Abuse, reconciliation, usability and accessibility evidence accepted
Security, Inclusive Design and CDO approvals recorded
D6 handoffs published and dependencies mirrored

items.title: Design the web assistant, BYOK and custom endpoint management
items.outcome: The web assistant makes model output, citations, derivation, refusal, draft confirmation, provider trust, quota and recovery state understandable without exposing secrets or bypassing deterministic workflows.
items.context: AI combines advice, prompt-injection, key, retention and cost risks. A chat box cannot carry the required provenance, refusals, confirmation and configuration lifecycle.
scope: Question/answer, citations, derivation, refusal and deterministic fallback
Natural-language transaction draft/correct/cancel/expire/confirm
History off/opt-in/list/export/delete
BYOK add/replace/revoke and custom endpoint validate/pending/cancel/suspend
Quota, provider status, disclosure and account-recovery states
acceptance_criteria: Every model answer is visibly model-generated with provenance and current disclaimer
A draft cannot write until every field is visible and explicit confirmation succeeds idempotently
No frame, error, toast or export renders a raw provider key
Step-up, cooling-off, notification cancellation and post-recovery suspension are complete flows
T-AIP-04 receives a D6 handoff covering every state and security test ID
contracts_schema: Maps T-CON-14, T-CON-16, quota, provider and assistant refusal/history states
security_privacy: No client-direct provider interaction or secret storage
Prompt/answer content is absent from analytics and design examples
observability: Refusal outcome, citation open, draft cancel/confirm, key lifecycle and quota state without content
rollout_rollback: D6 handoff precedes T-AIP-04 Ready
Assistant/configuration features can be disabled independently while deterministic product remains
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs. Assistant, draft and provider-settings frames use separate branches over one disclosure and trust component set.
definition_of_done: All assistant/configuration screens and states registered
Comprehension, accessibility and security review accepted
Compliance, Security and CDO approvals recorded
D6 handoff published and dependencies mirrored

items.title: Design web billing, plan lifecycle and notification preferences
items.outcome: Users can understand which channel grants their plan, quota, invoices, grace, cancellation, restoration and notification choices without dark patterns or policy-invalid actions.
items.context: Play and web billing can disagree and policy varies by region. Preferences also include immutable security messages and timezone behavior, so generic settings are insufficient.
scope: Plan/channel/quota summary
Invoice/credit note detail and download
Upgrade/downgrade/grace/cancel/restore
Cross-channel conflict and regional capability states
Notification class/channel matrix, quiet hours and unsubscribe
acceptance_criteria: Current plan, pinned version, granting channel, quota and reset are distinguishable
Only server-permitted regional/channel actions are rendered and policy absence fails closed
Cancel and restore have equal discoverability and no preselected retention trick
Invoices, credits, grace and conflicts state what happened and next action
T-BIL-09 and T-NOT-03 receive complete D6 mappings
contracts_schema: Maps billing lifecycle/version/channel and T-CON-11 notification preference states
security_privacy: No card or provider credential collection
Immutable security notifications cannot be disabled
observability: Plan comprehension, cancel/restore completion, channel confusion and preference save without financial values
rollout_rollback: D6 mappings precede implementation Ready
Policy-invalid actions remain absent on rollback
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs. Billing and preference sections are separate branches sharing plan/status and form components.
definition_of_done: All billing/preference screens and policy states registered
Comprehension and dark-pattern tests pass
Billing, Compliance, Content and CDO approvals recorded
D6 handoffs published and dependencies mirrored

items.title: Design the web trust centre, privacy controls and support journeys
items.outcome: Authenticated and locked-out users can understand consent, access, privacy, export/deletion and support status through complete, accessible and non-enumerating web journeys.
items.context: Trust is a set of operable controls, not policy links. Support must work when auth fails, and rights/deletion need truthful progress and failure rather than instant-success theater.
scope: Consent purpose list/detail/grant/withdraw consequence
Transparency/access events and analytics opt-out
Privacy mode, export, correction, deletion and rights request status
Authenticated support list/detail/thread/attachment
Unauthenticated support intake and account-existence-safe result
acceptance_criteria: Consent withdrawal shows consequence before confirm and keeps unrelated product usable
Generated transparency handles a new event type without a new bespoke frame
Deletion/export show step-up, progress, partial failure and verified completion
Unauthenticated support framing is identical whether an account exists
T-TRU-03 and T-SUP-03 receive complete D6 mappings
contracts_schema: Maps T-CON-09 and T-CON-11 consent, rights, transparency, support and attachment states
security_privacy: Support attachments preview limits and reject secrets/raw messages
Access events reveal no prohibited operator identity or hidden resource
observability: Consent comprehension, rights task completion, support discovery and attachment rejection without content
rollout_rollback: D6 handoffs precede trust/support implementation Ready
If fulfillment is unavailable, intake fails honestly and preserves statutory escalation
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs. Trust and support subteams share governed consent, status and attachment components with separate flow ownership.
definition_of_done: All trust/support screens and failure states registered
Comprehension, privacy and accessibility evidence accepted
Compliance, Security, Content and CDO approvals recorded
D6 handoffs published and dependencies mirrored

items.title: Design multi-currency web presentation and reporting controls
items.outcome: Web balances, exchanges and reports present multiple currencies with explicit rate, fee, source, age and derivation and never imply an unapproved combined total.
items.context: Localization and currency are independent. A multi-currency UI can create or hide money through presentation even when backend arithmetic is correct.
scope: Per-currency cards and grouped tables
Exchange-linked pair and fee/rate/source detail
Reporting-currency selection and conversion disclosure
Missing/stale rate and partial portfolio states
Export and chart labeling
acceptance_criteria: A mixed-currency fixture contains no unlabeled scalar total
Every conversion displays source, effective time, rate, fee and derivation
Missing or stale rates suppress converted totals without suppressing native values
Charts and exports retain original currency and conversion provenance
T-GLO-03 receives a complete D6 handoff
contracts_schema: Maps E30 money/exchange/provenance components and error states
security_privacy: Conversion presentation never sends financial values to an unapproved provider
Privacy mode masks original and converted values consistently
observability: Rate-stale state, conversion-detail open and reporting-currency change without amounts
rollout_rollback: D6 precedes T-GLO-03 Ready
Feature gate hides conversion while native-currency values remain
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs. Currency patterns extend approved planning/data components without editing their single-currency variants.
definition_of_done: All currency states registered
Money-path and localization tests pass
Globalization, Accessibility and CDO approvals recorded
D6 handoff published and dependencies mirrored

items.title: Validate and publish the complete customer web prototype and handoff
items.outcome: One versioned customer-web prototype connects every registered page and critical journey and supplies complete D6 manifests that frontend teams can implement without design invention.
items.context: Feature files can each look complete while navigation, cross-flow state, responsive behavior and shared components disagree. The platform gate tests the assembled experience.
scope: Connected signed-out and signed-in prototype
Desktop, tablet/narrow and 200 percent zoom variants
All critical journeys, deep links, cross-feature state and failure recovery
Per-ticket D6 handoff manifests and component/contract mappings
CDO platform readiness review and known-deviation register
acceptance_criteria: Every web screen/flow registry entry resolves to a prototype frame and D6 artifact
There are no dead links, orphan routes, unmapped components or mutable latest-only references
Critical tasks pass T-DQA-02, T-DQA-03, T-DQA-05 and T-DQA-07 evidence thresholds
Responsive, keyboard, screen-reader, localization and failure states are complete
T-DQA-12 receives a signed Web Design Lead and CDO readiness record
contracts_schema: Publishes web platform handoff manifest with artifact versions, screen/flow IDs, implementation and QA mappings
security_privacy: Prototype uses only synthetic data and least-privilege role fixtures
Public sharing is disabled and reviewer access expires
observability: Prototype dead link, handoff gap, unresolved design defect and approval age
rollout_rollback: Publish immutable D6 version before any mapped web ticket becomes Ready
Material change creates a new version and reopens affected dependencies
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo docs and web prototype page. Platform lead integrates immutable flow branches; feature designers retain ownership of defects in their frames.
definition_of_done: Complete prototype and all D6 manifests published
All required Design QA evidence accepted
Web Design Lead, Accessibility, UX Engineering and CDO approve
Declared dependencies mirrored as native GitHub blockedBy edges
